source: Saved twice-daily portal readings (e-Prohibition, LEMS, e-Sarkar). A month without readings is marked noData – no figure is estimated.

daily.note: Day-wise reduction in pending numbers from one saved reading day to the next (latest snapshot of each day). Positive = pendency reduced; negative = increased. Days with no reading are gaps, not zero. Average daily reduction = running total ÷ calendar days from the first reading to the last. Future portal refreshes append automatically.
daily.rule: reduction = previous reading − this reading; officer reductions only when the same officer appears on both days.
